sections.heading: Brazil Goes for the Championship
body: The Seleção is back. Six stars on the shirt, one dream in the heart.

sections.className: section center container grid grid-3 gap-xxl spacing-xxl
sections.heading: Why Brazil Will Win
body: Unmatched Speed — Brazilian forwards are the fastest in the world — on the counter-attack, no defence can keep up with the Seleção.
Depth of Squad — Brazil produces world-class talent at scale. From the favelas to the Maracanã, the pipeline never stops.
Tactical Clarity — No more uncertainty. The Seleção enters every match with a clear game plan, sharp pressing, and 100% fidelity to the coach's vision.
A Nation United — 200 million fans behind one yellow shirt. When Brazil plays, the whole country plays together — that energy is unstoppable.
Jogo Bonito — The beautiful game was born in Brazil. Every dribble, every flick, every nutmeg is a reminder of who invented this art form.
Five-Time Champions — Brazil is the only nation to have won five World Cups. The sixth is not a dream — it's a destiny waiting to be claimed.
Peak Performance — Brazil's training regime and technical staff are world-class. Every match-day lineup is fine-tuned for maximum impact on the global stage.
Adaptable by Nature — Brazil's squad can switch formations, styles, and rhythms mid-game. Flexible, resilient, and always dangerous — no matter the opponent.

sections.className: section center container grid grid-2 gap-m spacing-xxl container-6
sections.heading: The Brazilian Playbook
body: Everything that makes Brazil the greatest footballing nation. Nothing left out.
tiles: Set Pieces — Deadly from every dead ball situation.
Global Reach — Brazilian players light up every league on earth.
Samba Flair — Play with rhythm, creativity, and pure joy.
Attack System — Multi-layered attacking threats from all positions.
Night Mode — Brazil thrives under the floodlights — every big game is a Brazil game.
Match Schedule — Every kick-off counts. Brazil plans for every round.
Kit Design — The yellow and green is the most iconic jersey in football history.
Fan Power — Empower the most passionate supporters on the planet.
Live Stats — Track every goal, assist, and save in real time.
Youth Academy — Brazil's next generation is already in training.

sections.heading: The Road to Glory
body: From the group stage to the final whistle — Brazil's journey runs through the heart of this great nation.
The Seleção is proudly made across all of Brazil.

sections.className: section container center peek-background dark-scheme grid grid-4 gap-l spacing-xxl
sections.heading: Tactics, Passion, and Pure Football
sections.subheading: The philosophy that turns eleven players into an unstoppable force.

faqs.a: Brazil's best football has always been attacking. Sitting back is not in the DNA of the Seleção.
High press or patient build-up — Brazil's midfield can do both, adapting to any opponent's weak points.
Brazil's wide players are match-winners. Speed, skill, and end product — every cross could be a trophy-winning assist.
Brazil's new generation carries the legacy with pride. Youth is not a weakness — it is the future of the Seleção.

body: From Garrincha to Ronaldinho, Brazil has always produced players who make defenders look foolish. The dribble is not just a skill — it is an expression of freedom. Today's squad carries that tradition forward, entertaining the world one step-over at a time and reminding everyone why football is called the beautiful game.
